item.guhs.vetbootje_fluitje.lore: Whistle and your little grease boat glides over, however far it drifted.
item.guhs.vetbootje_fluitje.lore2: Smells like the fryer. No licking, nyeg.
item.guhs.vetbootje_werfboekje.lore: Pick the color, sail and name of your little grease boat.
item.guhs.vetbootje_werfboekje.lore2: With a grease stain on every page.
item.guhs.heteluchtballon.lore: Put it on the ground and it unfolds. Sneak + click folds it up again.
item.guhs.heteluchtballon.lore2: The wind steers. All you have to do is chonk.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.gekregen: You have your very own little grease boat! It smells like the fryer and adventure. Lost it? Blow your Grease Whistle.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.uitleg: Sail forward and back, steer left and right. %1$s = up, %2$s = down, a click on the deck = the chest. It's a little grease boat, not a racing guh: easy does it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.niet_van_jou: This little grease boat belongs to %s. Pawsies off, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.naar_huis: %s bobs off home. Just whistle when you need it again.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.leen.geen_kist: A loaner boat has no chest. It does have a Mika on its sail.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.fluit.geen: You don't have a little grease boat yet, nyeg. Take a good look around a grease ship at a Mika Fortress.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.fluit.aan_boor: You're already standing on it. Chonky, but true.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.fluit.geen_ple: Your little grease boat doesn't fit here. Find some more air, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.guh.te_vads: %s is too chonky for the cushion. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.guh.van_boord: Everybody off! Pawsies on dry land.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.guh.geen: No guh of yours nearby wants to sail along.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.werf.klaar: Freshly painted! Don't touch, it's still sticky.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.ballon.gekrege: You have your very own hot air balloon! Put it on the ground to unfold it.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.ballon.neergez: Hop into the basket. Sneak + click folds the balloon up again.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.ballon.uitleg: Hold %s = burner on = up. Let go = sink gently. The wind does the rest: at every height it blows another way. Watch the little vane on the basket.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.ballon.niet_va: This balloon belongs to %s. Pawsies off, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.ballon.opgevou: Folded up. Fits right in your pocket, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.ballon.lek: This old balloon has a leak. Pssst... gone. Your new one works just fine.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.ballon.geen_pl: There's no room here to unfold the balloon.
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.commando.geef: %s now has a little grease boat: %s
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.commando.geen: That didn't work (no little grease boat, no room, or an unknown color or sail)
gui.guhs.einde2_vetbootje.commando.ballo: %s now has a hot air balloon
%s has a new hot air balloon (the old one has a leak)
